source: A multilingual embedding model can train semantically corresponding texts from different languages to occupy compatible regions of one space. Modern models such as BGE-M3 and Qwen3 Embedding report multilingual training and evaluation across many languages. [17,18]
zh: 多语言嵌入模型可以训练来自不同语言的语义对应文本以占据一个空间的兼容区域。 BGE-M3 和 Qwen3 Embedding 等现代模型报告了跨多种语言的多语言训练和评估。 [17,18]
